manifest.changelog:
* Inline artefact references and campaign/suite topology membership.
* Results sync reports the campaigns it updated.
* Clearer API conflict and error responses.
manifest.postInstallMessage:
Open Bloom at $CLOUDRON-APP-ORIGIN and create your administrator account.

The instance starts with no accounts, so the first visit shows a setup screen
that asks for your name, email address and a password. It stops being reachable
the moment the account exists — nobody else can claim the instance.

Email — invitations, password resets and address changes — works only if you
enabled the Email addon for this app. Without it, the administrator you create
here is the only way in.

manifest.title: Bloom PLM by EmbedLabs
manifest.description:
Bloom PLM by EmbedLabs covers requirements, controlled documents, verification, risks, changes, defects, baselines and traceability.

Assign groups of policies per project and control access by document type and origin. Review and approve controlled documents, preserve approved revisions, and link change requests to versioned changes. Import Markdown and test cases, export test cases, and generate PDF reports.
manifest.changelog:
* Assign groups of policies per project, with separate application and access management.
* Control document access by type and origin, with independent review permissions.
* Review and approve controlled documents with notifications and email requests.
* Preserve approved content; linked approved changes advance Version and Revision on Save. Corrections keep their existing numbers.
* Upload and remove profile pictures; show them alongside users, comments and activity.
* Add a company logo to generated PDF reports.
* Import Markdown documents and test cases from CSV, XML and TestRail; export test cases and project PDF reports.
* Open linked test runs in Bud.
* Create Bloom defects from Jira issues.
